# 11Startups

> 11Startups (11startups.tech) is an applied AI company. We develop and fine-tune language models, build products on top of them, and offer AI consulting to startups and enterprises.

Products: CodeReportCard (a code-quality CLI on npm), Pebble mk1 (a 100k-parameter language model you train in your browser) and GrindSDE (interview-prep problem sets with C++ solutions). Full detail for each is in the documentation.

## Products

- [Products overview](https://www.11startups.tech/products): the three products with links.
- [CodeReportCard](https://www.npmjs.com/package/codereportcard): zero-config code quality report card for React, JavaScript and TypeScript projects. Run `npx codereportcard .` (Node.js 18+, MIT). 324+ npm downloads.
- [Pebble mk1 (100k Params)](https://how-llms-work.scalable-api-free.workers.dev/chatbot): train a tiny Qwen-style language model from scratch on your own CPU, in the browser, then chat with it.
- [GrindSDE](https://grindsde.app/): NeetCode 150 and Striver's SDE Sheet, 341 problems with C++ solutions, templates and comparisons.

## Documentation

- [Product docs](https://www.11startups.tech/docs): install, usage flags, scoring, configuration and CI setup for CodeReportCard; how Pebble mk1 and GrindSDE work.

## Services

- [AI consulting services](https://www.11startups.tech/services): strategy, rapid prototyping, workflow automation, data analytics, AI safety and compliance, ongoing support.
- [Pricing](https://www.11startups.tech/#pricing): Starter, Growth and Scale plans, monthly or yearly, in USD or INR.
